lines.text: Right now, one hundred and ninety-three car park stations are running across our network.
Sooner or later, something breaks. The question is: who finds out first?
ParkOps Watch Dog watches every one of them.
Take CK36, on the first of October.
At eleven oh three, both lanes went dark. Two lane stations and two cameras, all at once.
Twenty-three seconds later, Watch Dog had flagged all four.
Which site. Which lane. Exactly which device.
At eleven fifty-nine, the site's PMS PC went down, and came back two minutes later. By twelve oh four, everything was green again.
And it does this for every station, every day, typically within sixteen seconds.
